Legend has it that a lost tribe of dwarves settled on an island near Yalahar. Discover the hidden city of {wiki:Beregar|Beregar} beneath Fenrock and help its inhabitants in a series of missions: repair the elevator, prove {npc:Nokmir}'s innocence, deliver a chocolate cake, save the emperor's son from the trolls and bribe a guard with beer. You get access to the Beregar mines, {item:Dwarven Legs}, {item:Rusted Armor}, {item:Crystal of Focus}, {item:Gold Ingot}, {item:Small Topaz|Small Topazes} and, at level 100, the {item:Firewalker Boots}.

There is a legend about a long-lost tribe of dwarves that is said to have settled on one of the islands around Yalahar. One day, a brave warrior returned from a voyage and described in detail a huge city he had discovered, inhabited by dwarves, but nobody believed him.
No minimum level for most of the quest; **level 100** for the {item:Firewalker Boots} part (Pythius the Rotten). Recommended 60+.
Mission *Going Down*: 3 {item:Gear Wheel|Gear Wheels} (to trade {item:Iron Ore} for Gear Wheels you need to have done {wiki:The Sweaty Cyclops Quest|The Sweaty Cyclops Quest}).
Mission *The Good Guard*: {wiki:The Ultimate Booze Quest|The Ultimate Booze Quest} completed.
to open the crevice in Fenrock, break rocks and the stone in the dragon lair
Royal Rescue: 3 for the repairs + 1 to make the Wooden Ties
to make {item:Wooden Ties} (use the saw on a Wood)
buy from Harog during the mission
to load and unload the coal
A melee weapon (to break a wooden fence)
The Good Guard: buy from Boozer in Venore for 3000 gp (only during the mission, 1 per person, weighs 300 oz)
Being able to buy {item:Rust Remover} from Harog
First part of the quest: talk about Mistrock with {npc:Maris} once you are in Mistrock ({key:mistrock}) and use the {item:Pick} on the crack in the Fenrock cave.
You need Premium and access to Yalahar.
Ore cart between the start of the path (Fenrock) and Beregar
On your first visit, when you activate the cart on the yellow floor south of {npc:Nokmir}.
Beregar Mines (east, north, west and south mines)

East mine with *Going Down* ({npc:Xorlosh}'s elevator); north mine with *Justice for All* ({npc:Nokmir}'s door); west mine with *Sweet as Chocolate Cake* ({npc:Frafnar}); south mine with *The Good Guard* ({npc:Grombur}).
The missions inside Beregar can be done in any order once you reach the city, but *Justice for All* and *The Royal Rescue* need *Going Down* done first.
When you go to fetch Rerun's ring (Justice for All), also pick up the {item:Gold Ingot} right next to it.
When you hand the ring to the emperor, ask him for the mission *The Royal Rescue* right away so you do not have to make the trip twice.
Leave *The Good Guard* for last: you have to go to Venore to buy the {item:Dwarven Ale} and you need 300 oz of free capacity.
If you get lost on the way to Beregar and run into {creature:Diabolic Imp|Diabolic Imps} or {creature:Dragon Lord|Dragon Lords}, you turned the wrong way.
You only need a {item:Pick}. At the end of this part you have access to the Beregar mines.

If you are not in {wiki:Yalahar|Yalahar} yet, take a boat there. For example, in Venore talk to {npc:Captain Fearless} at the city's northern harbour: {key:hi}, {key:yalahar}, {key:yes}. In Yalahar, leave the boat and go to the docks of the {wiki:Foreigner Quarter|Foreigner Quarter}, in the **northwest** corner of the harbour.

To leave Yalahar by boat later, {npc:Karith} (on the boat at Yalahar harbour, 1 floor up) only takes you to the other cities after you complete the mission *Searoutes around Yalahar* of the {wiki:In Service of Yalahar Quest|In Service of Yalahar Quest}.

Go to the docks of the {wiki:Foreigner Quarter|Foreigner Quarter} in Yalahar (1 floor above ground level) and talk to {npc:Maris}. Ask him for passage to **Mistrock**: {key:hi}, {key:mistrock}, {key:yes} (100 gp).
Once in Mistrock, talk to {npc:Maris} again: say {key:hi} and {key:Mistrock}.
This dialogue is **mandatory**. If you do not talk about Mistrock with Maris, the {item:Pick} does not work on the crevice in Fenrock.
Now ask {npc:Maris} for passage to **Fenrock**: {key:hi}, {key:fenrock}, {key:yes} (50 gp from Mistrock).
Using the pick on the crevice

Enter the mountain and go down **two floors** to floor -2, the cave of the {creature:Tortoise|Tortoises} and {creature:Crocodile|Crocodiles}. In the **southeast** corner there is a crevice in the stone floor. Use the {item:Pick} on it: you are teleported down.
Following the path to the first NPC

Follow the path down. You will only run into {creature:Skeleton|Skeletons}, {creature:Goblin|Goblins} and {creature:Rotworm|Rotworms}. On the way you pass an ore wagon that you cannot use yet. Keep going until you find a dwarf NPC.
If you take a wrong path you may fall into areas with {creature:Diabolic Imp|Diabolic Imps} and {creature:Dragon Lord|Dragon Lords}. If you see them, turn back.

When you find {npc:Nokmir}, walk a little **south**: there is another ramp. Go up it and you find an ore wagon on the yellow floor. Use it to activate it. From now on you can use the wagon at the start of the path, which saves you a lot of time on your next visits. The wagon at the start of the path is at {coord:32604,31339,11} and the one in Beregar at {coord:32607,31510,13}.
You can now talk to the NPCs on the main floor about the missions.
Wagon at the start of the path (Fenrock side)

Whenever you want to return to the surface, take the path in reverse: the Beregar ore wagon saves you the walk back to the start of the path; from there go back through the Fenrock caves to the surface. On the Fenrock coast, {npc:Maris} takes you back to Yalahar: {key:hi}, {key:yalahar}, {key:yes} (100 gp).
To get back to Beregar on another visit, use the same path: {npc:Maris} → Fenrock → Tortoise cave (floor -2) → crevice → ore wagon.
You need 3 {item:Gear Wheel|Gear Wheels}. Reward: access to the east mine, where there is a {item:Gold Ingot}.
Go to the elevator and talk to {npc:Xorlosh}: {key:hi}, {key:mission}, {key:yes}.

{item:Gear Wheel|Gear Wheels} drop from {creature:Diamond Servant|Diamond Servants}, {creature:Iron Servant|Iron Servants}, {creature:Golden Servant|Golden Servants} and {creature:Worker Golem|Worker Golems}. Alternatively, trade 3 {item:Iron Ore} for Gear Wheels with {npc:A Sweaty Cyclops} in Ab'Dendriel. {npc:A Sweaty Cyclops} lives on the 4th floor of a tower northeast of the Ab'Dendriel depot: you get there through a small {creature:Rotworm|Rotworm} cave under the wheat field east of the depot. Then go back to Beregar via the Yalahar → Fenrock route.

To trade Iron Ore with the Sweaty Cyclops you must have **asked Xorlosh for the mission** and completed {wiki:The Sweaty Cyclops Quest|The Sweaty Cyclops Quest}. You can only trade 3 per person and only during the mission.
Go back to {npc:Xorlosh} and say {key:hi}, {key:mission}. You can now use the elevator (teleport) to the east mine.
Do not go for the {item:Gold Ingot} yet: wait until you have the mission *Justice for All*, because Rerun's ring is right next to it and you can only pick it up after accepting that mission.
{npc:Nokmir} has been accused of stealing Rerun's ring. Prove his innocence. Reward: 3 {item:Small Topaz|Small Topazes} and access to {item:Rust Remover|Rust Removers}.
Talk to {npc:Nokmir} at the entrance of the north mine. Say {key:hi}, {key:mission}, {key:ring}, {key:Grombur}, {key:rerun}, {key:rehal}.

Go up one floor to the ore wagon level and then climb the three stairways (keep going up) until you find {npc:Emperor Rehal} in the north of the main room. Say {key:hail emperor}, {key:nokmir}, {key:Grombur}.
Go to the entrance of the south mine and talk to {npc:Grombur}: {key:hi}, {key:nokmir}, {key:rerun}.
Finding the ring in the east mine

Use the teleport next to {npc:Xorlosh} to enter the east mine (you need to have done *Going Down*). Find the beer barrel in the **northwest** corner of the mine and use the crystals right next to it: you receive {item:Rerun's Ring}. Check your inventory and backpack.
The crystals where Rerun's Ring is
The mine is full of {creature:Dwarf Soldier|Dwarf Soldiers}, {creature:Dwarf Guard|Dwarf Guards} and {creature:Dwarf Geomancer|Dwarf Geomancers}. The Geomancers drain a lot of mana.
On the skeleton **west** of the beer barrel there is a {item:Gold Ingot}. It is not needed for the quest, but you are right next to it.
The skeleton with the Gold Ingot
Handing the ring to the emperor
Go back to {npc:Emperor Rehal} and say {key:hail emperor}, {key:nokmir}. Nokmir is declared innocent.
While you are at it, ask the emperor for the mission *The Royal Rescue* ({key:mission}) right away, so you do not have to come back on purpose.
Talk to {npc:Nokmir} again: {key:hi}, {key:mission}. He lets you through the door to the north mine.
Enter the north mine. In the **north** of the mine you find 3 {item:Small Topaz|Small Topazes}.
3 Small Topaz. You can also now buy Rust Removers from Harog.
From now on you can buy {item:Rust Remover|Rust Removers} from {npc:Harog}.
{npc:Frafnar} is in love with the barmaid. Reward: {item:Crystal of Focus}.
Talk to {npc:Frafnar} at the entrance of the west mine: {key:hi}, {key:mission}, {key:yes}.

Use {item:Flour} on a {item:Bucket} of {item:Milk} to get a {item:Lump of Cake Dough}. Use that dough on a {item:Bar of Chocolate} to get a {item:Lump of Chocolate Dough} and bake it in an {item:Oven|oven}. You receive the {item:Chocolate Cake}.

Go up all the stairs of the main room to halfway to the emperor (to the **west** of the stairs that lead to the emperor) and find the bar. If the door is closed, use the lever to open it. Go down and head south to the bar.
Talk to {npc:Bolfona}: {key:hi}, {key:chocolate cake}, {key:yes} and, when she asks who sent it, {key:Frafnar}.
If you misspell the name and lose the cake, the quest does not end: when you talk to Frafnar and he asks whether you said the cake was his, lie and say {key:yes}.
Go back to {npc:Frafnar}: {key:hi}, {key:mission}, {key:yes}. He gives you access to the west mine.
In the west mine, go to the room to the **north**: the {item:Crystal of Focus} is in a chest.
Location of the chest with the Crystal of Focus
The emperor's son has been captured by trolls. You need to have done *Going Down*. Reward: {item:Dwarven Legs}.
Asking the emperor for the mission
Talk to {npc:Emperor Rehal} ({key:hail emperor}, {key:mission}) to start the mission. If you already asked for it when finishing *Justice for All*, you do not need to go back.
Go to {npc:Xorlosh} and ask him about the {key:tunnel}. He sends you to the Beregar library to look for a book about tunnels.
Reading the book in the library

In the Beregar library, the {item:Tunnelling Guide (Book)} is on the bookshelf at the back, **on the second shelf counting from the bottom**. The book explains everything about the repairs: if you forget what to do during the mission, read it again.
The library bookshelf with the Tunnelling Guide
Buy 2 {item:Metal Fitting|Metal Fittings} from {npc:Harog}. Also make the {item:Wooden Ties}: use the {item:Saw} on a {item:Wood}.

You will make several repairs and, after most of them, use a wagon to move on. The wagons only go one way: if you try to go back you are taken to the main room of Beregar. That is fine: if you use the wagon in the main room again, you are taken to the last point you completed, so your progress is saved.
Using the lower wagon in the main room

Make sure you have in your inventory 3 {item:Wood}, 2 {item:Metal Fitting|Metal Fittings}, 1 {item:Wooden Ties} and 6 {item:Nail|Nails}. The wagons are in the main room of Beregar. Use the **lower** one, which goes to the *Deeper Mines* (see the sign on the wall).
Wagons in the main room of Beregar
The wagons in the main room; use the lower one

You arrive in a room with a rail cut by a hole. Use the {item:Hammer} on the hole between the rails to place the wood. Use the {item:Hammer} a **second time** to place the rails. Then use the wagon to get to the other side.
Second wagon: shoring up the tunnel

Here the tunnel arch has collapsed and gravel is blocking the rails. Use the {item:Bricklayers' Kit} on the missing part of the wooden structure to shore up the tunnel. Then use the {item:Pick} on the rock blocking the rails to break it. Now you can use the wagon.
Where to use the Bricklayers' Kit and the pick
Third cart: go around the broken bridge
The bridge is broken. Go back through the tunnel on the **left**: you are teleported to the other side. Go down the stairs.
The tunnel that takes you to the other side
After the stairs, go left, following the north wall. Go down the hole and go right, always staying next to the north wall. When you reach the broken bridge, go up the stairs and use the cart.
Along the way you meet weak creatures like {creature:Gozzler|Gozzlers} and {creature:Stone Golem|Stone Golems}.
7. The Royal Rescue: the cart room and the crane
You reach a room with carts hanging above the rails. You have to get the steam-powered crane working so it lowers a cart.
Push the empty cart **east** to the end of the rail, where there are piles of coal. Use the {item:Shovel} to fill the cart.
Take the coal to the crane
Push the full cart back to the crane and use the {item:Shovel} to unload the coal into the crane's engine.
Taking the cart back to the crane
Use the {item:Fire Bug} to light the engine. Then walk **several times in a row** over the {item:Bellow|bellows} to keep the engine running.
The bellows next to the crane's engine
If you are alone you have to be quick: the flame alone cannot keep the engine going without air.
When the crane is working and you see the steam, use the crane's lever to put a cart on the rail. The carts, from left to right, lead to:
**The rail maze** (this is the one you need to continue)
A room with a small quest: you pick up 10 {item:Brown Mushroom|Brown Mushrooms} from the {item:Glimmer Cap Mushrooms|Witches' Cap Mushrooms}
A small tunnel with 4 {creature:Stone Golem|Stone Golems}
Before going to the maze, use the 3rd cart to collect the 10 Brown Mushrooms.
8. The Royal Rescue: the rail maze
Use the levers to change the rail switches and take the cart to the different tunnels. If you are not sure of the order, work backwards from the destination tunnel.
The tunnels, starting from the bottom-left corner and going clockwise, lead to:
Back to the coal room (using the first cart)
A tavern infested with {creature:Spider|Spiders}, {creature:Poison Spider|Poison Spiders} and 2 {creature:Giant Spider|Giant Spiders} behind webs
Map of the rail maze and the levers
You can use the levers in a different way to earn the secret achievement **Unlikely Pathfinder**.
Use the levers to take the cart to the tunnel **north of the centre** and use the north cart at the start of the room. Once in the central tunnel, go **north** and go up the stairs.
If you go east you meet {creature:Fire Elemental|Fire Elementals}, {creature:Fire Devil|Fire Devils} and a few {creature:Furious Troll|Furious Trolls}.
Talk to {npc:Tehlim}: {key:hi}, {key:mission}, {key:yes}. His brother was captured by the trolls.
Go back to the maze room using the cart. Use the levers to go to the **right** tunnel, which leads to the troll hideout.
9. The Royal Rescue: the troll tribe
There are many invisible traps on the floor that summon 2 to 4 {creature:Mechanical Fighter|Mechanical Fighters} when you step on them. You cannot avoid them.
Kill the {creature:Furious Troll|Furious Trolls}, go up the stairs and fight your way to a teleport. Step into it: you appear one floor up.
Follow **steps 1 and 2** in the image to a {item:Chest (Quest)|chest} and take the {item:Prison Cell Key} from it.
The chest with the Prison Cell Key

Go back to the portal and follow **steps 3 to 6** in the image. On the bridge you meet {creature:Furious Troll|Furious Trolls} and {creature:Troll Legionnaire|Troll Legionnaires}, some of them invisible, who block your way until you kill them.

There are {creature:Troll Legionnaire|Troll Legionnaires}, {creature:Furious Troll|Furious Trolls}, {creature:Mechanical Fighter|Mechanical Fighters} and {creature:Lavahole|Lavaholes} shooting fire. The Lavaholes' damage is high: use a {item:Dragon Necklace} and do not linger.
If you are a mage, summon a {creature:Demon Skeleton} to absorb the Lavaholes' fire while you use area runes on the trolls.
Go down the hole and follow the **right** passage to a prison with a berserker. A section of the wooden fence is weak: break it with your weapon and use {spell:Levitate} to go down.

Kill the {creature:Orc Berserker|berserker} and follow the passage, killing trolls and {creature:Mechanical Fighter|Mechanical Fighters}, to the prison. Talk to {npc:Rehon}: {key:hi}, {key:mission}. He keeps the key.

Go back to Beregar: return the same way to the rail maze room (where you went down with {spell:Levitate} you have to go back up with *exani hur up*) and use the cart to the 3rd tunnel, which leads back to Beregar. If you try to walk backwards on one of the one-way carts, you are also taken to Beregar's main room. Then talk to {npc:Emperor Rehal}: {key:hail emperor}, {key:mission}, {key:yes}.
You need to have done {wiki:The Ultimate Booze Quest|The Ultimate Booze Quest} and have 300 oz of free capacity. Reward: {item:Rusted Armor}.
Talk to {npc:Grombur} at the entrance of the south mine: {key:hi}, {key:mission}, {key:yes}.
Buy the Dwarven Ale from Boozer

Go to Venore and talk to {npc:Boozer}, 2 floors above the central depot: {key:hi}, {key:dwarven brown ale} (or {key:mission}) and {key:yes}. Pay 3000 gp. If you have not done {wiki:The Ultimate Booze Quest|The Ultimate Booze Quest} yet, you have to do it first (say {key:mission} to start it). To return, {npc:Captain Fearless} at Venore's north port takes you to Yalahar ({key:hi}, {key:yalahar}, {key:yes}) and from there you continue with {npc:Maris} to Fenrock and Beregar.
You can only buy the Dwarven Ale **after** accepting the mission, and only 1 per person. It weighs 300 oz.
Enter the south mine. On the **northernmost** branch of floor -2 from Grombur, there is a skeleton with the {item:Rusted Armor}.
Map of the south mine with the location of the Rusted Armor
You need **level 100** and a {item:Golden Mug}. Below level 100 you can enter the dragon lair, but the pick does nothing to the stone in the boss chamber.

There are two paths to Pythius's chamber. The one in the table starts at the ore wagon at the start of the path (Fenrock side, {coord:32604,31339,11}); there is also a route from the Beregar cart ({coord:32607,31510,13}), on the second map. Follow this path, using the map:
Go south and go down the stairs.
Go south-east and go down the stairs. (Going up leads to {creature:Fire Elemental|Fire Elementals}.)
Go west and go up the stairs, to the south.
Go up the stairs: you meet two {creature:Elder Bonelord|Elder Bonelords}.
Go down the stairs to the west.
Keep going west and take the first stairs to the south. (At the far east end of this passage there are stairs down with two {creature:Giant Spider|Giant Spiders}.)
Keep going south and go up the stairs at the south end of the cave (there are only a few {creature:Skeleton|Skeletons}).
Go up 2 floors (there are {creature:Goblin|Goblins}). Keep going east and go down the stairs.
Keep going east and north following the curve (more Goblins). Go up the stairs at the end of the passage.
You meet {creature:Dragon|Dragons} and {creature:Dragon Hatchling|Dragon Hatchlings}. Follow the passage west to the end and go down the stairs.
Go down 2 more flights of stairs. You reach a chamber with a teleport to the north; Pythius is at the far west end and does not attack.
Map of the path through the Fenrock dragon lair
Alternative route from the Beregar cart to the dragon lair
Pythius the Rotten guarding the treasure chamber
Start: cart on the Fenrock side
Talk to {npc:Pythius the Rotten}: {key:hi}, {key:mission}, {key:undead}, {key:treasure}, {key:yes}, {key:offer}, {key:yes}, {key:golden mug}. He opens the teleport to the north for a few minutes.

Enter the teleport and go down two floors. Here there are {creature:Dragon Lord|Dragon Lords} and {creature:Dragon Lord Hatchling|Dragon Lord Hatchlings}. Go **west** and follow the yellow path until you find a stone in the corner of the last chamber, to the **south-west**.
Dragon Lord cave: follow the yellow path
Open the teleport with the pick
Use the {item:Pick} on the stone to uncover a teleport that leads to the final chamber.
The stone where you use the pick

In a large chamber, fight {creature:Pythius The Rotten (Creature)|Pythius the Rotten}. There is an escape teleport on the west side, close to you. Pythius does not die: when his health bar turns black he shouts *"Fighting little worm, your victory shall be rewarded"* and you are teleported to the reward room.
The fight against Pythius the Rotten

If the fight goes badly, use the escape teleport on the west side of the chamber. After the reward room, go back the way you came to the ore wagon and from there to Beregar or the Fenrock surface (and {npc:Maris}).
The carts of the mission *The Royal Rescue* save your progress: if you have to go back to Beregar to fetch something, the cart in the main room takes you to the last point you completed.
The 10 {item:Brown Mushroom|Brown Mushrooms} are a small optional quest on the 3rd cart in the crane room.
